rules_evaluated.evidence: Strategy doc names M5's mood as ‘learning through contrast’ (‘I can feel what packaging adds now; I couldn’t have read it as a lecture’). The file's arc honours it: the student opens already holding the un-packaged M4 return (L23 ‘You sent off an un-packaged session. You walk in with the artefact.’), spends the body diagnosing it and building packaging against named failures, and the closer hands the contrast forward (L120 ‘Module 6 reads the packaged session: subtler misses, subtler drift.’). Student leaves this piece having felt the gap packaging closes, set up to read a second, subtler gap at M6. No beat resolves the mood into closure early.

Diagnosis is framed as data, not blame, throughout: L44 ‘Where the return bears it out, the worry names your first check... the artefact wins: it is first-hand data from the session itself, and the worry is not.’ Maintainer block L144 records the explicit correction away from blame-flavoured wording (‘the nag is a spec’ rejected because it puts the feeling, not the artefact, in charge) and the trainer push-back script for ‘Phase 1 diagnosis-as-blame’ (L195) explicitly counters shame-framing (‘the diagnosis is data, not blame’). No line frames the un-packaged run as the student's failure.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Big Idea (L4) leads with ‘Steer your long session’ — a positive discipline, not a failure word. Section headers lead with disciplines too: ‘Say what done-done means’, ‘Your mid-run worries hint at missing checks’, ‘Inspect your results’. Failure vocabulary (goal drift, context rot, plausible-but-wrong) appears only inside the What You'll Learn bullet (L15) as the named cases the discipline addresses, not as a section title.

grep -ni 'eval' over the raw body (L1-124, maintainer block excluded) → 0 hits. Strategy doc §M5 states ‘eval is embargoed at M5 ... The word appears nowhere in M5's body text, by design’ and the module's own maintainer block (L155) records the same embargo. Verifier-shape handle used is ‘LLM judge’ (L17), matching the doc's ‘shipped handles are LLM judge / deterministic shell-hook / Ralph re-feed—not background-agent verifier’ (§M5). Ronacher's three-pattern is not named in student-facing body text (only in the maintainer Frameworks list, non-student-facing), honouring the doc's ‘nothing may name the three pieces before the M4 evidence is read’ constraint.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategic themes recur in Key Concepts.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Key Concepts (L64-67), each walked against check_strategy_tie_in.md's own AE101 theme list (90% correct / compounding / mirror / self-awareness / capture-your-world / non-agentic-default): (1) ‘The model already knows the public field’ → 90% correct / mirror instance; (2) ‘The missing evidence is the interaction of this task, model, repository, and setup’ → capture-your-world / self-awareness instance (local specificity); (3) ‘The experiment promotes a candidate to tested-here; the local optimum stays ahead’ → compounding instance; (4) ‘The agent makes evidence cheap; the engineer decides what it means and what becomes durable practice’ → non-agentic-default / self-awareness instance. 4 of 4 bullets read as a theme instance — exceeds the 2-3 floor. Maintainer block L146 (Antti-decided 2026-08-15) additionally records these four lines as fixed and verbatim; judges should not re-file for expansion.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Key Concepts shape — theme breadcrumbs, not standalone section.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Section carries no breadcrumb clause and no `Remember:` wrapper; all four bullets are the module's own tactical voice with no closing hook. Rule 6 makes breadcrumbs optional decoration on 1-3 survivors, not a floor to hit, and the maintainer block (L146, L153, dated 2026-08-15 and 2026-08-27) explicitly declines expansion, records the block as exactly four lines, and directs judges not to re-add a fifth line or mechanics bullets. Cutting-before-decorating gate (§§3/4/5) already checked PASS above, so no survivor is being denied a breadcrumb it earned; the maintainer's own call is to ship undecorated.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: What You'll Learn shape — capability register, not syllabus.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Five bullets (L15-19), each a verb + immediate object in engineer register: Diagnose / Pair / Build / Assemble / Re-send. No Bloom-tag parentheticals, no `by mapping/walking...` mechanism tails, no author-defence asides (`not a...`, `without...`), no didactic taxonomy stamps. L15's tail (`grounded in quoted moments from the return`) names the evidentiary standard of the student's own diagnosis — the artefact contract, not a description of how the curriculum teaches — so it reads as carve-out (c), a brief operational qualifier that would leave the bullet cryptic without it, not a mechanism tail. L16 was cut from a three-way pairing enumeration to the bare pairing instruction per maintainer L144(b) — matches the accepted current form. Verb-grammar-fit: no strategic-theme verb is used to lead a concrete-artifact bullet (the failure mode §7 warns against), and §7 explicitly says an absent theme verb is not itself a finding.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy doc carries strategy, not structure — §§1-7 bind curriculum→doc, this one binds doc→curriculum.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: rule binds the strategy doc's own restraint from restating structure; not a property of this curriculum file to score — see notes for a doc-side drift found while reading
